answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 1627 Country: India Title: A Ghair Muqallid call himself muslim. But they says it is good to prayer for magfirath of Nabi-e-Kareem Sallahhu alaihi wasalam (mahaz allah). they says anyone who offer good salah can reach to the level of Nabi-e-Kareem Sallahhu alaihi wasalam (mahaz allah). Keeping in view what we have to think of them a muslim or non-muslim. is it valid to say salam to them or avoid them. Question: A Ghair Muqallid call himself muslim. But they says it is good to prayer for magfirath of Nabi-e-Kareem Sallahhu alaihi wasalam (mahaz allah). they says anyone who offer good salah can reach to the level of Nabi-e-Kareem Sallahhu alaihi wasalam (mahaz allah). Keeping in view what we have to think of them a muslim or non-muslim. is it valid to say salam to them or avoid them. Answer ID: 1627 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 634/631=N) One should pray for promotion of the Prophet?s grade and maqam-e-mahmood (exalted position) for him, one should not seek forgiveness for him since the prophets are sinless: قال تعالی: انا فتحنا لک فتحاً مبیناً لیغفر لک اللہ ما تقدم من ذنبک و ما تأخر (الآیۃ) و الانبیاء علیھم السلام کلھم منزھون ای معصومون عن الصغائر والکبائر والکفر والقبائح (شرح فقہ اکبر: 68) By offering good salah one can not reach to the level of the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), but what did the person mean by this sentence: ? anyone who offers good salah can reach to the level of Nabi-e-Kareem Sallahhu alaihi wasalam?. Ask the same person to write what he meant from this sentence, and then we shall answer the question in detail. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
